prs.location:
Quayside Quarter is conveniently located in Dublin Docklands, only 5 minutes from the Docklands rapid rail station (DART) and directly next to the Spencer Dock light rail station (LUAS).
From Quayside Quarter, Point Square can be reached in approximately 1 minute on foot, while offices in the IFSC are approximately 4 minutes away on foot. Dublin Airport is approximately 20 minutes away by taxi.

Dublin Docklands Neighbourhood
The neighbourhood draws its inspiration from the fabric of Dublin and the rich industrial heritage of the Docklands, infused with contemporary Scandinavian architectural accents and Brooklyn loft-style design. Curated wild landscapes sit alongside bustling streets with restaurants, cafés and stores. A riverfront boutique hotel anchors the area, contributing to a vibrant new neighbourhood.

Contact Quayside Quarter
To contact a member of the Quayside Quarter site team, email team@qquarter.com or call 01 5395960.
prs.aboutDevelopment:
Greystar Ireland Management Services Limited manages some of Ireland's best residential communities on behalf of property owners - bringing professional, responsive and resident-first management to renters across the country.
We are part of Greystar, one of the world's largest rental housing companies, with homes and communities across the US, Europe and beyond. In Ireland, our team has been managing apartments and student accommodation since 2019, with properties across Dublin and Galway.
When you rent through us, you get a dedicated on-site team, a digital resident app for maintenance requests and communications, and the backing of a professional management company that takes its responsibilities to residents seriously. We are regulated, transparent and here for the long term - not a short-term landlord.

Our communities are designed for people who want more than just four walls - they want a well-maintained home, a responsive team when something goes wrong, and a building they're proud to live in.

description:
Quayside Quarter, Dublin Docklands

Experience a better kind of renting at Quayside Quarter. Nestled within Dublin Landings on the riverside in the heart of Dublin Docklands, Quayside Quarter offers apartments designed for comfortable riverside living in the heart of the city.

Located on the peninsula of the River Liffey, premium apartments at Quayside Quarter benefit from uninterrupted views over the River Liffey, while standard apartments overlook peaceful internal courtyards. Quayside Quarter sets a new standard for rented apartment living in Dublin.

12 Months of Free WiFi for New Residents
Quayside Quarter is now offering 12 months of free WiFi for new residents, providing seamless connectivity from move-in and enhancing the living experience with this special offer.

Resident Amenities at Quayside Quarter
The pet-friendly apartments at Quayside Quarter offer residents access to a range of amenities and services, including:

 - 24/7 concierge
 - Resident gym
 - Pet-friendly development
 - 24/7 onsite maintenance and management
 - Private gym
 - Co-working spaces
 - Residents' Lounge
 - Communal roof terrace areas
 - Sustainable-style living with secure bike storage and electric car charging
 - Parking available by separate negotiation
 - Dry cleaning services
 - Residents' Lounge, Co-working Spaces and Private Gym
 - Designed to refine the work-life balance, the Residents' Lounge is an elegant and considered space created to meet the needs of residents. It includes hot desks, meeting spaces and a games area for downtime, providing a space made for collaborators.
 - The private gym is flooded with natural light and features a raw industrial aesthetic.

Design Inspired by Dublin Docklands
The development draws its inspiration from the fabric of Dublin and the rich industrial heritage of the Docklands, infused with contemporary Scandinavian architectural accents and Brooklyn loft-style design.

Parking, Bike Storage and Apartment Options
Quayside Quarter also offers car parking spaces, secure bike storage, a concierge service and landscaped gardens.
All apartments are pet friendly, and residents can choose from furnished or unfurnished options across a variety of layouts, with some apartments offering waterfront views.

Contact Quayside Quarter
To contact a member of the site team, email team@qquarter.com or call 01 5395960.
